name: Senki Ryoujokuki
source:
A digital novel about the captain of the royal knights, who has been charged with training seven princesses.
The novel describes how he wears down their resistance.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031376.html]DLsite English[/url]]
